outcomes.text: The noise fades within a few minutes; you stop on the path, breathing hard, and find the bites shallow but numerous — ugly, not dangerous.
You outrun the sound easily; checking yourself, one bite on the calf is deeper than the rest and still welling blood.
You run further than you meant to before the quiet catches up with you, and only then notice you're favoring the leg the Warden raked.
You stop at what you take for a safe distance and realize the mill's noise never really reached this far — you'd outrun it long before you thought.
Checking the bites, you find the skin around two of them has gone faintly grey, spreading slow as you watch, matching nothing you know of rats.
You stop, breathless, and find the bites already closed to thin white scars, as if days had passed over your legs alone.
